title: Alert German Shepherd Sitting on Sunny Lawn, 1956 B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A full-length snapshot of an alert German Shepherd sitting obediently on a grassy lawn under bright sunlight, casting a sharp shadow to its left. Behind the dog are leafy garden bushes and a handmade wooden crate or shelter box. The bottom white border is date-stamped 'SEP 56' and features decorative deckled edges typical of mid-1950s American family snapshots.
